item.title: 20 Aug — The vig is quadratic; use it
item.description:
Private — Head of Products
Tonight is a concept issue. The external tape was thin in our window; instead, here’s a tight playbook for turning our fee constraint into an advantage.
What matters for PredictStreet - Our fee math is a feature if we use it. The taker fee is a fixed 240 bps, quadratic in P*(1−P); maker is 0 on‑chain by design. That creates predictable post‑fee breakevens and lets us …
